tenderSchedule.title: Repair, Servicing and Refurbishment of 1No. Generator Transformer (GT) Oil to Water Heat Exchanger of Sharavathy Generating Station, KPCL, Jogfalls-577435
tenderSchedule.description: The brief scope of work includes the shifting of Generator Transformer oil cooler from customer site and carry out the complete repair/Refurbishing and servicing 1No. of Generator Transformer oil to water heat exchanger with replacement of water tube bundles with gaskets & pressure testing and return back the heat exchangers to customers site with good condition along with necessary test reports.
tenderSchedule.locationName: KPCL Executive Engineer ODY Office SVP Jog

generalCriterionList.description: Tenders  from Joint ventures are not acceptable.

Bidders shall not be under a declaration of ineligibility for
 corrupt and fraudulent practices issued by Government of Karnataka
The Bidder shall ensure credit of Tender Processing Fee into the respective receiving bank accounts of e-Procurement on or before the last date of bid submission.

It shall be the responsibility of the Bidder to ensure credit of Tender Processing Fee and EMD into the respective receiving bank accounts of e-Procurement on or before the last date and time of bid submission.
EMD Payments through e-Payment mode shall be made as one single transaction and payments made in part are liable for rejection.

The bidder is required to ensure browser compatibility of the computer well in advance to the last date and time for receipt of tenders. The departments shall not be responsible for non-accessibility of e-Procurement portal due to internet connectivity issues and technical glitches at bidders end.
Conditional tenders will not be accepted.
The tender is of two tender document system
Aspiring Bidders/Contractors who have not obtained the user ID & Password for participating in e-Procurement, may now obtain the same from the website https://kppp.karnataka.gov.in/

Corrigendum/ modification/corrections, if any, will be published in the website only. For any clarification on e Procurement, can be contacted to office of the Executive Engineer ODY Jog, Sharavathy Generating Station, KPCL, Jog falls 577435, Sagar Tq, Shimoga Dist, Karnataka, Mob:9449379545, Ph No 08186244606, Fax No 08186244753, e-mail ees3.kpclatgmail.com, or HP HELPDESK 080 23010900/ 23010901
Sections I, II, III, Instruction to bidders, Form of Bid are part of the Tender document

The bidder shall quote in Indian Rupees only. The bidder shall quote his rates excluding/exclusive of GST and inclusive of Transportation, Packing & Forwarding, Freight & Insurance, Loading & Unloading etc., Insurance & any other miscellaneous expenses as per the latest GOK/GOI orders
After evaluation of Technical Bid and whose offer meet the PQR and technical specification of the tender/bid in complete manner will be accepted and only such bidders Financial bid will be opened
The quantity of materials and work mentioned/indicated in tender may vary depending on the requirement at the time of placing of the work order

KPCL reserves the right to verify the authenticity of any or all the certificates furnished by any or all the tenders from the authorities who have issued the same. If it is found that any of the agency/agencies have furnished false certificates/ information, the tenders submitted by them are liable for rejection
Tender with stipulation for settlement of dispute by reference to arbitration will not be accepted and tender with conditions are liable for rejection
Rates of each item is to be quoted in e-portal only

Bidders are advised to visit the work site at Sharavathy Generating Station before bidding to obtain the hands on information about the quantum of work and supply involved from the concerned division head, thorough view of location of work place, arrangements required to execute the work and safety arrangements for execution of work. Further, post tender correspondences regarding technical specification, scope of work and supply involved will not be entertained and it is the responsibility of the bidders to get any queries cleared before bidding for subject work
Prices should be entered in Tender schedule (Financial Bid) in the website itself and Prices will be evaluated based on the rates quoted in Financial bid of the website only

technicalCriterionList.description: Bidder shall be a regular manufacturer/authorized dealer/Agency having proven experiences in the field of manufacture/repairs of oil to water heat exchangers to power utilities/reputed organizations. In proof of the above, copy of Work Order & corresponding work Completion certificate for at least one single order for similar type of works with the contract value not less than Rs.4.34Lakhs should be furnished
